Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Charles Richard Robb <cr...@Isis.MsState.Edu> wrote:
>Are you able to play action modifiers on a reaction?

Action modifiers augment actions, not reactions.

>Can you play action modifiers upon another Meth's acting Vamp if it has
> the skill required?

Only if the card lets you use it on someone other than the minion with the
appropriate discipline (e.g. superior Cloak the Gathering), and the other
action is being taken on your turn.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Charles Richard Robb <cr...@Isis.MsState.Edu> wrote:

>Can the Rack be moved to other Vamps or must it stay with the original
>if it is not stolen

It can only be moved to a new vampire if it changes controller. If the
Rack's beneficiary is whacked, the Rack will be useless until stolen.

'scuze me? When did Action Modifiers become restricted to being played
only on your turn? (I know that it is effectively true, but why are you
cluttering the rules to state what is obvious except to further restrict
a (future) otherwise valid use of an action modifier).

You'd think the fiasco with Reaction cards vs. Madness Network would've
set stage for more logical and less phase-restricted rulings.

L. Scott
